description: Open web steel joist assembly. One counted joist (COUNT EA) drives one joist order line carrying the driver designation, erection labor hours, and crane minutes (P29).
provenance: SEED 2026-06-12. Hour factors seeded pending PC7 shop actuals and Owner review. Changes are file diffs proposed to Owner, never chat-session overrides.

materials.description: open web steel joists, one per counted joist

labor_hours.description: joist setting and bolting, hours per joist

notes: Joist bridging is span-dependent and never derivable from a count alone; bridging enters the takeoff as manual LINEAR rows. Joist weight derives downstream from the SJI load table named in formula_ref, never from AISC and never from model memory.
